title: Avocado Cream vs Glutathione Cream: Which One Suits Your Skin?
ex: Avocado cream is for comfort and softness, glutathione cream for a brighter, more radiant look. Texture, who each suits, using both and cost per month.
rt: Avocado Cream vs Glutathione Cream: Which One? | Mirc Glow
rd: Avocado cream vs glutathione cream: what each does, texture, who each suits, how to use both on alternate nights, and an honest cost per month comparison.
quick: Avocado cream is about moisture and comfort, so it suits dry, tight-feeling skin. Glutathione cream is radiance-focused, for a brighter, more radiant-looking finish over 8–12 weeks. Many people use both on alternate nights, with sunscreen every morning. Neither changes your natural skin colour.
facts: Avocado cream: comfort and softness, often felt by the next morning.
Glutathione cream: a gradual, brighter-looking finish over 8–12 weeks.
Alternating nights makes both jars last longer.
Both Mirc Glow creams contain kojic acid, so wear sunscreen daily.
